banner: Educational prototype · Solana test network · No real money
meta.description: Every transfer splits. Part takes root. An educational prototype on Solana's test network.
tagline: Every transfer splits. Part takes root.
lang.label: Language
landing.lead: Send money home. Save a little every time, automatically.
landing.demoHint: No wallet needed. You get a practice wallet with test dollars.
landing.connectHint: Have a Solana wallet on devnet? Connect it instead.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.1.title: Set your split
landing.how.1.text: Choose once how much of each transfer goes into savings, from 0% to 50%.
landing.how.2.title: Send
landing.how.2.text: One transaction pays your family and buys a savings bond at the same moment.
landing.how.3.title: Watch it grow
landing.how.3.text: Interest builds every second. Anyone can see what the bond raised and how the money was used.
landing.live.title: On the test network right now
landing.why.title: Why this matters
landing.why.1: Nepal received Rs 2.36 trillion (about $16.19 billion) in remittances in fiscal year 2025/26.
landing.why.2: In 2015, only about a third of one savings bond issue for migrant workers was sold.
landing.why.insight: Saving fails when it is a separate step. RemitRoot makes it part of sending.
landing.disclaimer: A model for regulators and licensed remittance operators to evaluate. A real version would need regulatory approval.
demo.failed: The practice wallet could not be set up.
onboard.title: Start with a practice wallet
onboard.text: You need a wallet with test dollars to send. The demo sets one up for you in a few seconds, with a practice family wallet to send to.
send.title: Send money home
send.lowSol: This wallet is almost out of test SOL for fees. Getting test dollars also adds a little SOL.
send.projection.title: In 12 months at this rate
send.projection.note: An illustration for 12 monthly transfers, not a promise.
send.recipient.title: Sending to
send.recipient.name: Name (only on this device)
send.recipient.invalid: Enter a valid Solana address for your family.
send.recipient.self: Your family's wallet must be different from yours.
send.series.title: Savings go into
send.series.none: No bond is open for savings right now. You can still send with a 0% share.
send.goal.invalid: Enter a goal amount, or remove the goal.
send.ruleNote: Your split is saved on-chain and used for every transfer until you change it.
send.notEnough: You have {balance}. Enter a smaller amount or get more test dollars.
send.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
send.paused: RemitRoot is paused by the admin. Sending and claiming are stopped for now; redeeming still works.
send.matured: This bond has matured and takes no new savings. Choose another bond or a 0% share.
send.full: This bond has reached its cap. Choose another bond or a smaller share.
goal.eta: About {months} more transfers at this rate
goal.etaOne: About 1 more transfer at this rate
sent.title: Sent
savings.title: Your savings
savings.empty: Nothing saved yet. Your first transfer with a savings share will show here.
savings.claimed.done: Paid {amount} of interest to your wallet.
savings.claimNothing: Interest builds every second; there is less than a cent to claim so far.
savings.bondLink: See where the bond money goes
history.title: History
history.empty: No activity yet. Your transfers, interest and redemptions will appear here.
history.loadingNote: Read from your recent transactions on the test network.
family.title: Family view
family.lead: What your family sees: money received, and the savings being built for them.
family.lookup.title: Whose family view?
family.lookup.text: Enter the family's wallet address to see what they received and the savings being built for them.
family.savings.text: Savings bonds held by the people who send to this family. They pay back with interest at maturity.
family.senders.empty: No one sends to this wallet with RemitRoot yet.
bonds.title: Savings bonds
bonds.lead: Every bond series on the test network. All figures are read live from the chain.
bonds.empty: No bond series has been created yet.
bond.solvency.title: Can the vault pay savers?
bond.owedNote: Savings not yet redeemed, plus interest earned so far.
bond.solvency.covered: The vault covers everything owed today.
bond.solvency.short: The vault is {gap} short of what is owed today. The issuer must repay before every saver can be paid.
bond.proceeds.title: Where the money went
bond.proceeds.empty: The issuer has not used any funds yet. Each use will be listed here with its purpose.
bond.notFound: This bond series does not exist on the test network.
bond.verify: Check this bond on the explorer
bond.testNote: A test bond with test dollars. Not an offer and not a promised return.
issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.lead: The bond issuer uses funds with a public, stated purpose, and repays the vault before savers are paid.
issuer.needWallet: Connect the issuer's wallet to manage a bond. Everyone else can follow along on the public bond pages.
issuer.notIssuer: This wallet does not issue any bond series. Issuers on the test network:
issuer.withdraw.title: Use funds
issuer.withdraw.needPurpose: Write what the money is for. It is recorded on-chain for everyone to see.
issuer.repay.title: Repay the vault
issuer.repay.suggest: Needed to cover what is owed today: {gap}
issuer.repay.covered: The vault already covers what is owed today.
issuer.admin.title: Emergency pause
issuer.admin.text: While paused, nobody can set a split, send or claim interest. Redeeming after maturity always works.
